ann.t: Resignation — Ganga Forging Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Hiralal Mahidas Tilva as Chairman & Managing Director of the company w.e.f. November 05, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Ganga Forging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Updates — Ganga Forging Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of Letter of Offer for Rights Issue '.

Rights Issue — Ganga Forging Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on Jun 25, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 2, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 1.63 per share.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Appointment of Internal Auditor for the FY 2026-27
Outcome of Board Meeting — Ganga Forging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Ganga Forging Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Updates — Ganga Forging Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Machine Readable Form/Legible copy of Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2025'.
